meta.title: Local Model Delegate
meta.description: Delegates mechanical text work (translate, summarize, extract, classify, rewrite) to a local cheap model endpoint so the main model stops spending tokens on low-value transformations. v0.4 adds per-workspace local AI involvement levels (none/light/default/high/max) with a scoped planner policy and local_worker delegation, plus an opt-in SlaveAgentTeams mode for running several local or cloud slave subagents in parallel while coexisting with native Agent Teams. v0.5 turns SlaveAgentTeams into a single-switch automatic mode: every mounted LLM route/model is discovered at spawn time, local routes are preferred, a failed node is retried on the next one, and the endpoint chain (primary + fallbacks) is registered as llm-pi-ai routes automatically on save.
